notes.title: Dungeons of Hinterberg – Final Quality of Life Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey there adventurers, 

We’re rolling out our final Quality of Life update packed with general fixes, polish, and some key improvements focused on combat flow and responsiveness. 

We’ve listened closely to your feedback and made tweaks to ensure that every dungeon battle feels smoother, sharper, and more satisfying — whether you're chaining magic abilities, dodging elite enemies, or just vibing with your sword and board. 

Update Highlights: 

Smoother UI and inventory management and handling 

Better visuals and immersion: New VFX  

Customisable sound experience: Option to turn off speech bubble sound effects. 

Improved localisation: Sharper Japanese fonts and better Chinese combo counter readability. 

New Game+ combat tweaks: Fine-tuned for a smoother late-game experience. 

Village life enhancements: HP/MP auto-reset at nightfall, and Luisa now changes into pyjamas for a better nights sleep, pre-slaying! 

We hope this update makes your time in Hinterberg even more magical. 

A Heartfelt Thank You 

Since launch, the outpouring of support for Dungeons of Hinterberg has meant the world to us. From the stunning fan art to the amazing reviews and comments — you've made this journey unforgettable. 

As a small independent studio, working on our first game it has truly meant the World, every player you share the love with and every review you leave makes a difference to us in so many ways 

Our dream was to create a game that transports players into a truly original world: a hidden village nestled in the Austrian Alps, where ancient magic, modern tourism, and Alpine folklore meet. Seeing you all connect with the characters, puzzles, and stories of Hinterberg has been a dream come true. 

 

💸 Biggest Discount Ever – Live Now in the Curve Publisher Sale! 

If you've been thinking of visiting Hinterberg — or want to gift a getaway to a fellow adventurer — now's the perfect time. Dungeons of Hinterberg is available at its biggest-ever discount as part of the Curve Games Publisher Sale. Don’t miss it! 

🛒 https://store.steampowered.com/sale/curvepublishersale2025 

 

🧳 What’s Next? 

With this update complete, the team will now be taking a well-earned rest (and maybe a real hike or two through the Alps 🌲). We’re incredibly proud of what we’ve built — and who knows? Perhaps the next adventure is already whispering in the mountain wind... 

Thank you for being part of Hinterberg. 
 We'll see you down the trail.

notes.title: Free Winter Icons update available now!
notes.content:
[b]🎄 ‘Tis the Season in Dungeons of Hinterberg! New Free Holiday Costumes! 🎅🦌
[/b]
Adventurers of Hinterberg, the holiday season is upon us! 🌨️ As the snow falls and the fire crackles, we’re thrilled to bring you two brand-new, FREE seasonal cosmetics to help you celebrate the most magical (and mischievous) time of year! 

Introducing the Santa Costume 🎅 and the Krampus Costume 👹—now available in Dungeons of Hinterberg! 


[b]🎅 Santa Costume: Spread the Joy! 
[/b]
Step into the boots of the jolliest figure of all time! Feel the warmth of the season as you spread cheer (and maybe the occasional sword swing) across the slopes and dungeons. 

Did you know? Santa Claus has origins in folklore as Saint Nicholas, a 4th-century Greek bishop known for his generosity and miracles. Over the centuries, this figure blended with other winter traditions to become the Santa we know today—full of festive magic and good will! 

 
[b]👹 Krampus Costume: Embrace Your Dark Side! 
[/b]
For those of you who prefer a more... mischievous approach to the holidays, the Krampus Costume is here to channel your inner trickster. With twisted horns, fur-lined robes, and a menacing grin, you’ll be the fearsome folkloric legend of Hinterberg! 

Krampus, the horned creature of Alpine folklore, was said to punish naughty children during the festive season, often depicted as the shadowy counterpart to Saint Nicholas. With roots in pre-Christian traditions, Krampus represents the dark side of winter—where the line between celebration and chaos blurs. 

[b]How to Unlock the Costumes: 
[/b]
Both costumes are available to purchase in the shop.  No grinding required and you’ll be ready to strut your holiday style in no time. 

Get into the holiday spirit (or mischief) and dive into Dungeons of Hinterberg with your new seasonal outfits! Whether you’re delivering presents or punishing those who misbehave, the season is yours to celebrate. 

Happy Holidays from all of us at Microbird Games! 🎄

notes.title: Vote Now for Dungeons of Hinterberg for Outstanding Visual Style
notes.content:
As always, we would like to thank the community for taking Hinterberg into your hearts and sharing that appreciation with us.

It’s now that time of year when independent developers around the World make their pitches to receive a coveted Steam award and we hope you might support us in our bid for Outstanding Visual Style!

From the moment we set out to create Dungeons of Hinterberg, we knew that the art style had to be as captivating as the story itself.  The game’s visual aesthetic isn’t just eye candy—it’s a key part of the experience that draws players into its magical world of mystery and adventure.  Inspired by the stunning beauty of the Austrian Alps, the game’s aesthetic brings together the charm of traditional folklore and a modern, cel-shaded art style to create something truly unique. Whether you’re exploring quaint Alpine villages or battling mysterious creatures in hidden mountain dungeons, every scene in Hinterberg should feel like stepping into a vibrant hand-crafted World.

But Dungeons of Hinterberg is more than just a feast for the eyes. The game’s visual style works hand-in-hand with its storytelling to bring to life a rich world of Austrian legends and myths. As you journey through the game, you’ll encounter a diverse cast of characters, each with their own backstory, quirks, and challenges. From mystical creatures inspired by local folklore to the charming townsfolk who populate the villages, every interaction is designed to deepen your connection to the world of Hinterberg.

We’re proud of how Dungeons of Hinterberg has resonated with players around the world. The game’s art style is more than just beautiful visuals—it’s a vital part of the immersive experience that makes Hinterberg feel alive.

If you’ve been captivated by the vibrant landscapes, the atmospheric lighting, and the intricate character designs that bring this magical world to life, we’d be honored to receive your vote in the Steam Awards. You can cast your vote for Dungeons of Hinterberg in the Outstanding Visual Style category by visiting our Steam page or casting your vote at the top of this post!

notes.title: Celebrate the New Game+ Update with a Dungeons of Hinterberg Midweek Deal!
notes.content:
Dungeons of Hinterberg has been selected for a Midweek Deal and is now 50% off for a limited time to celebrate the release of our New Game+ update!  There’s never been a better time to dive into Hinterberg’s magic—whether you’re picking it up for the first time or ready to relive the adventure with fresh features and exciting new ways to play. Don’t miss out—join players around the world in experiencing Dungeons of Hinterberg like never before! 
 

Here are some highlights from the New Game+ update. You can find a full breakdown at the end of the post. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/bcf3c2ada57f164f75b09ccce20c0aae7605a5fa.jpg[/img]

[b]ENGAGING REPLAYABILITY [/b]

The main goal of New Game+ is to provide players an enhanced second playthrough. You can play through the game from the start, while keeping your last playthrough's inventory, player stats, and most of the perks that you received from relationship level-ups! In addition, you can choose to either keep your past relationships or reset them and build them again from scratch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/cd1d670e061e1930a2288c6bd1bbf4998ab32e99.png[/img]


Enemies will pose a greater challenge. Some will have new melee shields; others will boast increased ranges or more intense attacks. Also, more enemies will have magic shields in general.  

To help deal with these nastier enemies, we’ve added 4 new attack conduits to give you additional combat options. 



[b]Downpour[/b] - Giant water projectiles that rain down from the sky. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/3dd42779ebe210908c05c6bf8154c5915c2c3d27.png[/img]

[b]Piercing Glance [/b]- Numerous eyes open in the void around Luisa, shooting lasers in all directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/7016aeab2a99029e0ff75476ed2d0aa0dd292748.png[/img]

[b]Rage[/b] - Luisa's speed and damage is increased for a short period, while damage taken is also reduced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/2867bd2e644511d9032623ce4413547b6b121d99.png[/img]

[b]Wind Dash[/b] - Luisa dashes forward, damaging everything in her path. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/39eb391ac4e0a9c9c0f1979ad1d139cf5fe7f69d.png[/img]

We’ve also added some more outfits for your customization pleasure. Some of them you’ll find at Olivia’s Outfits in town, while others will be received on satisfying certain criteria. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/1fdab2d9127a22560972e869402be704daecd565.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/55bdba9bc12be95436e6048648d2ad049641132c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/2c946f4b5a23acee1f235c10dc2c80751a038630.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/21863a48e8d607457cfd9b008624440d532013e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/b0a751a656695ce34db48e619b3df12dfcf90e53.png[/img]

To top it off, we’ve added ‘Armor Visuals’ which apply when using Luisa’s base outfit only – This allows players to see the armor they’re equipping, along with providing amazing new looks for pads, leggings, and body armor! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/82d8367dcf57fb568741d3abc6e36197e123f8ae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/fc57c237078df45064a0600b2ad66d19b0790788.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/fb0b2b2a838565d967f54cbb803e093ccfc28bfa.png[/img]

Finally, 9 new achievements will provide more goals to work towards, offering new challenges for seasoned players looking to test their skills.

You can play through the game from the start, while keeping your last playthrough's inventory, player stats, and most of the perks that you received from relationship level-ups! In addition, you can choose to either keep your past relationship progress or to reset it.

notes.title: Dungeons of Hinterberg is Out Now!
notes.content:
The day is finally here – we’re so excited to share Dungeons of Hinterberg with you! We hope you’re excited to delve into Hinterberg and discover what it has to offer! Here’s a rundown of Hinterberg and the different areas you can visit on your Slaycation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/38f3b61e9f15255df1f73db5209b7ea1d6f77dc9.jpg[/img]

🤫  9405348779

The first place you’ll visit will be Hinterberg itself. You’ll spend a lot of your slaycation here, getting to know the locals as well as fellow adventurers. It can be a bit overwhelming, being on your own in a new place, but never fear, Theresa, your host, will be more than happy to guide you in the right direction! Once you’re settled into your hotel, she’ll let you know where to go to get trained so you’re ready for some monster slaying! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/2437a8b533c2d85f7d3b5a6c2e4a2b3d7726d9d9.jpg[/img]

Another place you’ll visit will be Hinterwald, a beautiful, autumnal forest. There are plenty of places to relax and take in the magnificent scenery here, as well as opportunities to fly through the forest, feeling the wind flowing through your hair! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/c614fd7140040a0522b0392ed4019e46a7e6faa4.jpg[/img]

It wouldn’t be a holiday in the Alps without some snow – when you head up to Kolmstein, you’ll finally get to carve on your magical hoverboard! You can ride the rails into Ice Caves, challenge fellow adventurers on the Slalom, and even make the most of some exclusive transportation options up there…if you know the right people! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/87546d41ffb259863da9223916b700b27a474624.jpg[/img]

You’ll also visit the swamps of Brünnelsumpf! Offering a very different vibe to the other areas, here you can kayak through the tranquil marshes and face new monsters. So long as you don’t mind the rain, Brünnelsumpf is a very serene place to spend a day, with plenty of dungeons to keep you busy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/35a2afc8327f80aa2372ead1e873234f6afb700a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hinterblog #3 - Dungeon Details!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! 

We’re back with a brand new Hinterblog, and as promised in our recent Hinterblog – [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1983260/view/4039234937581736029?l=english]Biome Break Down![/url][/b] we’re diving deeper into the dungeons! 
 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeWxmdzl2b3VzZzNqODM2cXpmbHRnb3BqanpmaGp6dWtxOTN3dnBtbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/B2TQagOLTFWRREFvZf/giphy.gif [/img]
[i]Ok maybe not diving, more like a steady decent [/i]

🤫  8487328801

 
“Dungeons of Hinterberg” is one big spoiler, yes we can confirm there are in fact dungeons, and yes they are located in a place called Hinterberg. Insert mind blown emoji am I right? 
 
Ok, now that we have that one big revelation out the way, worry not our spoiler avoiding adventurers, throughout this blog we’ll be focussing on elements of dungeons found in the early section of the game and won’t reveal any story plots. 

Back in Hinterblog – [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1983260/view/3953665275865443960?l=english]What is Hinterberg[/url][/b], we talked about how Hinterberg is a new tourism spot attracting adventurers and tourists from all over the world. In fact, some call it the ultimate slaycation. Wow, what a word, whoever came up with that deserves a raise, but why do they call it a slaycation? I’m glad you asked!  

Dungeons are “the” go to attraction for our visitors in Hinterberg. Yes, there are plenty of beautiful places to visit, activities to enjoy, people to meet, all adding to your slaycation, but dungeons are your chance to conquer your fears, put your puzzle solving prowess to the test, and slay some mysterious monsters. 

“Sounds like a challenge, I’m in!” 
 
I love your enthusiasm! 25 dungeons have appeared throughout Hinterberg and the overworlds within, but how do you enter them? 


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExamY0MG82ZmN5OHFkNHpqaWd3dWViano2OWRoYmF3NjN0bjhiaWl4cyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Nhkcprdra4RaN5fyYf/giphy.gif [/img]
[i]Portals are your doorway to each dungeon 
[/i]

Magical portals have appeared across Hinterberg, you’ll find them as you explore the four overworlds!  

 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZHYwOXQzNXpmN2xtemM5N2ltaG1ydmFmZjNqNHJtZzg0ZmV1cW9mNSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/E67mip1NM93o55pFi1/giphy.gif [/img]
Are you ready? 
 

Finding dungeons will be a challenge, and you may find you lack the strength to take on some. You’re free to leave overworlds and come back when you’re ready. 

Dungeons are going to throw many challenges your way, and depending on the overworld you’re in, you’ll rely on specific skills which you’ll acquire on your journey to defeat them. 

Not only will you be faced with magical monsters of varying difficulty, you’ll be faced with a series of puzzles that you’ll need to solve in order to progress though each dungeon. 

 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeXB4b3p5dDhhdWZjajl3a3NzejgxMXhyMXh1NW1jMGxkemt5MmpjaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/78GkxJPahmGZqhHVwF/giphy-downsized-large.gif [/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNGp4eG52eTYxNG51a3E5bmU1N3F1cHltbXQycTRmanh1NzEwbGIyYyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/F31exvA1s9mXXFQkNq/giphy-downsized-large.gif [/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZnZvY2xjdjJ3ODJkbW8ybXBnYjhyZ2d2Ynhhc3Z0azFqMDAydjFyMiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/4HE9ZIk5DBAIiuh3jY/giphy-downsized-large.gif [/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbWEzd3FoemRkc3QyNjV4cDlwczdxcG83M2o2YTlyYnQ4dDk5a3F4ZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/kxjlEwoGAKe5ZIwBcJ/giphy-downsized-large.gif [/img]
 
 
Dungeons are not to be taken lightly, be careful as you fight your way through, you never know what kind of dangers are waiting around each corner. 
 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeTBld2FpYXBweW04bWp0cTU3NGxraGl4Y201N3prYW9oOG5qbDdlbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/pJPUypej3PgQgRBVXj/giphy-downsized-large.gif [/img]
[i]Weee! This might look fun, but keep a close out for obstacles! [/i]
 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZzk1NGRmaGw5MWcwbnk4ejc2c3lpZHJkbXoyc29pNDkwNTF5bTI4aiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/uUHBRC6DYMxZQPeemw/giphy.gif [/img]
[i]What? You didn’t think you’d get an easy ride did you? [/i]
 

“Wow that sounds like a lot of hard work, what do I get for doing all that?” 


At the end of each dungeon you’ll find a Stamp Station. Make sure you stamp your book otherwise the exit portal won’t open, and you’ll want this to show off to all the locals and your friends and show them how many dungeons you’ve conquered and just how awesome you are! 

Oh one last thing, dungeons have loot, so it would be wise to explore! You may come across certain chests that you can’t open just yet, but we’re sure there’s someone in the village who could probably help with that... 

 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdjY3YXFncXpheGs5aWNrbDJ3NDdlcjdyNjIzMmpqZWpzdGJkaWtzYiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/wg9LTgj5XKuTh8aq3q/giphy.gif[/img] 
 

Right, book stamped! I’m outta here, until next time, slayers! 

In our next Hinterblog, we’ll be paying a visit to some of the characters you’ll meet on your journey! Stay tuned. 
 
For all things Dungeons of Hinterberg, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MicrobirdGames]Twitter (X)[/url], and join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/pDkuHGZwey]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Hinterblog #2 - Biome Break Down!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

🤫  3188316972

In our first Hinterblog “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1983260/view/3953665275865443960?l=english]What is Hinterberg[/url]”, we alluded to the fact you’ll be visiting 4 overworlds on your slaycation, and as promised, we're taking a closer look at those today! Not too close though, we want you to come visit and explore all the secrets on your own terms!

Each overworld has a unique biome, and each location includes a Skill Shrine. Skill Shrines are peculiar objects that can bestow magical skills upon you if you know the magic word of course. Magic skills will be necessary to help you traverse through that particular overworld, and for solving puzzles, especially in that region’s dungeons! Oh and, of course, you can use your newly acquired skills in combat too!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/NC8bhyjPfx9Q2ypH7L/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]Just say the magic word[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExajk0ZzJ0MXl3cng1d2hxYzh2YTEzeHRrdHZ3NTRlaDg5Y2MxdjFxdSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/LIOrJCs3T20otmM6y8/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]Magic skills will help you overcome obstacles and puzzles[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNWlyeTRpN3d6YTN6ZXEzZ3VtZDhxMmRlNDJia3F2cG03dGEwaHp0bSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/K5uUySm5fQffz5UFHw/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]C-C-C-C-Combo! Your blade paired with your magic skills will get you out of sticky situations[/i]

Speaking of dungeons, you’ll find several in each overworld, some harder to find and conquer than others. We’ll talk more about those in a future Hinterblog, but for now, let’s take a look at our first Overworld!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExa2dyZ21ycXBubXVmdXhrM25rdTJoZnlpZm55Z2ZidDFkZXByYjl4NCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/2LdKQoFqoSDTDi7p6R/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[b]Doberkogel[/b]

A sunny and lush mountain overworld with beautiful scenery, a lake, streams and waterfalls, and expansive vistas. Explore the labyrinth of mountain pines or meditate in a meadow, or hike to the top, but beware of the dungeon way up there!

We highly recommend speaking to fellow tourists and the locals, as some may offer useful tips and suggestions, like which areas you should explore.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNm5sM2dkNWo5bjRoMWlnZjg5bmttbWYzMjFsNHA1YXNvaHZhbmhyaSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/nZQkuZhGMvQnRwyeWO/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]Marina at Kiddie Land always puts a smile on our face[/i]
 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdjVtOWxsM294ZDJtbW8yMnZkN2JsaDNoZmVoaGxmZHhmM2psYWYzYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/l1XhxsG1jplORwD3Ps/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]What, did you think you’d just casually walk everywhere?[/i]
 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExc3Z0bXpkNHpvMno0a2plN2w0bTk2Y2tnczlqaW85bjhpMzRsZGhvbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/PM7LYtfj9ADttYBqSE/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]Skills can help you on the path to loot![/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdzI1aTRpcmo4NDVhMWMwb2ExMmI3NmEyZ2k2cGIxYjVvYmYxbmxwNCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Fu4DXaZm12Wbfwzq5E/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]The overworlds hold many secrets… but those are for you to find on your own[/i]

We hope you're wearing your thermals because it’s about to get chilly!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNnJ1djVueThlcjVqem9saHM5ODdvNWVxMHJ2NWRlZXFqM2dpbWdhOCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/jCktKA8yVCXVZZgttl/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[b]Kolmstein[/b]

A shimmering glacier overworld, with magical ice caves, crevasses, passes, and vast vistas. Meditate at a viewpoint, take a chairlift to the highest peaks, and hover your way on a magical snowboard through this enchanting overworld.
 
It's a challenge to traverse mountains on foot (due to all that snow you see…) So one of the first things you’ll do in Kolmstein is acquire a skill that lets you conjure up a magical hoverboard! Pretty cool right?

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNmVqOHl0M3BkbGpsbW5zYXVyMDk3YmQwYXdleWtlejByZ3ozZXc5MyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Q783aFqnatCrX1Nmz0/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

In Kolmstein, there are several environmental challenges that you’ll need to overcome to explore further. For example, magical rails will help you get around, but you may need to prove yourself to activate them.

[previewyoutube=KHZvXBLJ8KI;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Regina and Philipp who we met in our “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1983260/view/3702580714439101125?l=english]Meet the Microbird Team![/url]” blog show us how it’s done![/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbTZiOXE5bmtidG9zeXliaWo2bjZjMGxoYWZ1azllenl0NG8xM3QxcyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/KE3MvznSNGKRNMsBGk/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]Another challenge? No problem, we’ve got a magical skill for that![/i]

Ok, that’s enough of Kolmstein for now, I’m freezing! Let’s head on over to our next overworld.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbnA5NXJ2NTNhcDJxZTdnNmN6NXJlZXZ5bXl4YWlwNzFkeXNudW1zcyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/n0gAKRd6WIgS2EVpYj/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[b]Hinterwald[/b]

A deep and mysterious forest overworld teeming with wildlife… and secrets. Vines cover the ground in some places and make sure not to swim in the water, but if you avoid the hazards, you will be rewarded with fresh forest air and views of old windmills and water wheels, or maybe giant mushrooms?

Like the other overworlds, Hinterwald has its unique challenges and Magic Skills.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcTYyZ3lxNmV1ZGNmbDV0bWNyNjlhZDB0bWZzeml2YWk3MG03MnIyMiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/xtijSeAmahVJNmthyb/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]You spin me right round[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/br2fWyBVz4GNZce92w/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

While you’re out exploring, you may find that you’re not ready to take on particular dungeons just yet, or you might just want to return to the village. You’re free to leave overworlds at any time (or not even visit on certain days!). You can always come back when you feel ready. 

While you explore, you’ll come across these handy map boards. These boards will allow you to fast travel to other areas within the overworld you’re currently visiting.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdzVoOTVjaDNtdmZlNXFhMzd0cjhrbDNyMTg3MmE5ZzBrZzV5aDJ5eCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/aQq7m6LLcTqoyg0Red/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

Alright, we’re onto our final overworld! We’ve recently opened this up to the public, and we’ve prepared a short promo!

Welcome to [b]Brünnelsumpf![/b]

[previewyoutube=NTDxzuXGh4U;full][/previewyoutube]
A marshy swamp overworld that showcases the beauty of the wetlands. Constant rain does not detract from this biome’s quiet beauty, and you can meditate in a sheltered corner away from the wind. Take a kayak to visit all the different islands and solve puzzles. Lighthouses can help you on your way…

To find out more about Brünnelsumpf, visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983260/Dungeons_of_Hinterberg/]Store Page[/url] where we’re broadcasting a prerecorded playthrough!

We hope you enjoyed a closer look at some of the locations you’ll be exploring during your slaycation!

For all things Dungeons of Hinterberg, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MicrobirdGames]Twitter (X)[/url], and join us on [url=https://discord.gg/u2zWUDqRsq]Discord[/url]. 

If you’re interested in what you see, we’d love it if you’d consider adding Dungeons of Hinterberg to your Wishlist today! 😊

In our next Hinterblog, we’ll be diving into the dungeons! 👀 We’ll see you then!

notes.title: Hinterblog #1 - What is Hinterberg?
notes.content:
Dungeons of Hinterberg is a single player ARPG with social simulation elements, that takes you on a vacation to the Austrian Alps.

25 magical dungeons have appeared around the village of Hinterberg attracting adventurers and tourists from all over the world, some describing it as the ultimate slaycation!

You’ll be playing as Luisa, a burnt-out law trainee taking a break from her fast-paced corporate life to take on the Dungeons of Hinterberg!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExd2x4cWFpZ2tpaHMwenBjZnZhdnQwYXNpbGQ2dnExZWw0dTkwbmR3NCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/prk5oksybs0gyq8bYY/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]We could all do with a vacation, right?[/i]

Why have the dungeons appeared? What are all those monsters? Well, that’s something you’ll have to figure out on your own, but worry not, we’re a helpful bunch here in Hinterberg! We’ve put together a guide (a tourist guide of sorts, you might say), that will give you the rundown on some activities you’ll get up to in Hinterberg!

🤫  8300731591

Before we get into things, worry not you spoiler avoiding slayers. We’re not covering any story elements here. Hinterberg is something that’s best experienced by coming to stay with us.

Speaking of staying, Theresa has been hard at work at her guest house, making sure we’re ready for you when you arrive. Your room will be the start and end of your day, we’ll make sure it’s all cosy for you. Resting up is an important part of the slayer journey.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeWg3amFpcW5lcHZsM2VzbmQzeGZuZmY2eHA5ZGtwcjZpcGJuYWFiciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/TqEsFDkXKdKwMHhdKg/giphy.gif[/img]

In fact, relaxation is something we highly recommend: not only does spending time out of your day for yourself present you with some beautiful views, but it also helps in building up stats that will make you a stronger slayer. You’ll find many spots you can rest up in each overworld, and if you don’t feel like leaving the village on a particular day, you could always go visit the spa.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOHJqNzhnZjZuZjdhOWR6emhnMjQ4MGRkMTdicWZoamo1dHZpZGdtbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/faezK3aSQau8uIYBAj/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExam93cWdkaHJlOGdua25uNmUxZ2w2cmlwZmZrc3lnbmVhZXU0enQwdCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/BDq7HzyNqDzfmZ1WBQ/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Read more on some of the activities that will make your vacation memorable in our “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1983260/view/5424084302581082054?l=english]Relaxing in Hinterberg[/url]” blog[/i]

Now that you’re all relaxed and refreshed, let’s take a look at the “slay” in slaycation. In Hinterberg, you’ll visit 4 Overworlds, each with a unique biome and its own dungeons to conquer. We’ll take a closer look at the Overworlds in an upcoming blog!

Ever since those magical dungeons appeared, these mysterious monsters have been roaming these Overworlds and the dungeons within. You’ll be armed with your trusty blade and your magical skills. Each biome includes a magical skill shrine too, granting you skills that will be useful for that particular location.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYXJjeXltY2lucXFydmhjbDhrbDZiaTRwd2RwejhvYWRraHc1bGlmbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/dTbEzFnhcl21Kznntd/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
Find out more about some of the enemies you’ll face, in our “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1983260/view/3883854408808608687?l=english]Hinterberg’s Monster Problem[/url]” blog

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZm1tOTFib2Fqcm82ZW45ZG9renYybGJtNDc3c2doNW41aDRtNnprNiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/AWcVMwtO3HHEli8tkU/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Luisa approaches a Skill Shrine, wonder what she'll learn?[/i]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeWhjZnNiYmV6Ynp5YnE3djg4NGdvbXlidHQzazg0eXNlMWpxd2MzaiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/tNLa4geJ2v1PBrXVHa/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[i]Skill shrines offer you skills useful for your current location, like a handy hoverboard for traversing the mountains[/i]

Be prepared when heading out. If you get into trouble, you’ll have a hard time calling for help. Due to magicial interference, your phone won't work. We hear one of the locals may have an "olden day" device that works regardless of the magic interference!

Dungeons are “the” go to attraction for most of our visitors. Each dungeon will have its unique set of challenges, including puzzles to solve, and monsters to slay. At the end of each dungeon, you’ll find a stamp station which you’ll use to stamp your book, which you can show off to your friends back at the village to let them know just how many dungeons you’ve conquered! Just remember to Stamp, or else the exit portal won't activate!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcTFlOG8za3BweXJteHEydmZmamRhOWNrbXF2NWRlMTNkNXZ4dWdkeiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ZNe884MZ421G8PDC4g/giphy.gif[/img]

On that note, we’re sure you’ll befriend many of the other tourists and locals here. In fact, if we had to give one piece of advice, it’s to get out there and meet new people. You never know who can teach you that new skill, offer you an upgrade, provide you with insight or a useful hint, or maybe someone has the key to that one particular chest you couldn’t open up there in the mountains of Kolmstein? Who knows? Well, you will – if you go and mingle!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/bVC3VFiSacs1Z6w5ZD/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/14500a30c815c0343e4f92fb968f6919c5b40fd1.png[/img]

Once you’re done for the day and you return to the village, there’s many places you can meet new people and hang out, like the Krampus Bar for example!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExajVibzI3YmJubHlydHQyY3ZienlsdTZtaXI2ZzBhZmRhMjExcjFtdiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Q8Gxc9fxDGhh1A5SIM/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

Or maybe you just feel like going to see a movie, what? You didn’t think we’d have a cinema, but you were fine with magical dungeons?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/b3f307f67af79df3624e3083cb54bbca7e4104d8.png[/img]

Activities like watching a movie can also help with your stats, which you’ll need to build to become a stronger slayer to take on more challenging dungeons. Watching a fighting movie, for example, may help increase your attack damage.

Ooof that was a lot, and we’re just getting started! There’s a lot in Hinterberg we haven’t covered today, but keep your eyes peeled! We’ll be releasing more blogs soon, diving a little deeper into the game. Until then, I think we’ll head back to our room now and get a good night's sleep!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExa29ya2hvNTBqZ3dnaTIzbDYxZmNuNHpuOTVjdnR3YzFjYjl6bnBlcSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/87yfNgpEHExbu77kdU/giphy.gif[/img]

For all things Dungeons of Hinterberg, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MicrobirdGames]Twitter (X)[/url], and join us on [url=https://discord.gg/u2zWUDqRsq]Discord[/url]. 

If you’re interested in what you see, we’d love it if you’d consider adding Dungeons of Hinterberg to your Wishlist today! 😊

notes.title: Dungeons of Hinterberg release date, trailers, gameplay, and more
notes.content:
When was the Dungeons of Hinterberg release date? If you're in dire need of a vacation, then do we have the alpine resort for you! Dungeons of Hinterberg is the debut title from indie studio Microbird Games, and it's turned plenty of heads thanks to its striking ligne claire visuals and idyllic Austrian setting.

Dungeons of Hinterberg originally shot to the top of our list of upcoming PC games following Ken Allsop's Dungeons of Hinterberg preview. He described Hinterberg as "the place to be," offering players a "whimsical, colorful, and laid-back adventure" scaffolded by a Persona-style time system. notes.title: Relaxing in Hinterberg
notes.content:
So far, we’ve told you all about the fast-paced side of Dungeons of Hinterberg: exploring dungeons, fighting monsters, being a social butterfly. But sometimes, you just need to take a step back and chill. In fact, in Hinterberg, it’s encouraged – we’re all about balance here. Relaxing is an important part of any holiday and will even make you a better slayer!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/3459719ca254d7c35ec45164b19f5ce0c79d71ff.gif[/img]
In the village, you will have the opportunity to explore solo. You could take in a film at the Kino – there’s always something new to see, and certain films might even help you later in your journey…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/c3cffb1eeca18ed8f2fdc8aa9bd5dfecda06f2bc.gif[/img]
Or maybe you want to make the most of that fresh Alpine air! You could always go for a peaceful trip on the lake by renting a boat and taking in the beautiful village from afar. Or you can grab a drink and unwind on the terrace of your hotel, overlooking the village and listening to the merriment down below you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/de0db4eeb4b6ded18319f4a372547857d56bb7d6.gif[/img]
Maybe you'd prefer relaxation in the classic sense and would benefit from a trip to the spa, chilling out in the hot tub!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/8e0cffa4413afd011f356e3b53e27a3700087a3e.gif[/img]
There are also chances to loosen up outside of the village. If you’re deep in the forest, you might just stumble across a cosy cushion just begging you to get comfy and meditate for the afternoon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/a945e7155195c44c5418817e744c587ef1047b3c.gif[/img]
We want to make sure that while you’re having the slaycation of a lifetime in Hinterberg, you’re also taking some time for yourself! This balance is just one of the ways you can become an even more remarkable slayer!

notes.title: Making new friends in the Alps!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We thought it was about time we showed you a deeper dive into the social side to our gameplay! In this new trailer, we explore a day in the life of Luisa, what she gets up to and who she meets

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5KsLC7SrejM]Watch the Trailer Here![/url]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/eb5beb8fe2d160ac2d3345e1f9b21cccd8322a1b.png[/img]

You will begin each day at your guest house in the heart of Hinterberg. From here, you will decide which biome to visit for the day – each environment is unique and presents different magic skills to master, along with unique dungeons and challenges. 

Once you’ve made your way to your chosen biome, your first goal will likely be to find a dungeon to tackle. Whichever path you choose, you should be prepared, as the serene-looking environments will present you with many challenges; most of these can be overcome by using your sword, magic, and puzzling skills - but some might require the help of friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/6f3d090472807222addf2252a189088f7432fe14.png[/img]

This is where the social side of the game comes in. Hinterberg’s newfound fame as a magical slaying destination has brought colourful tourists and adventurers from all over the world to the village and has turned it into a bustling hotspot filled with things to do and places to hang out.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/4374f6486420d9a4e5a35873691f1ea192b10ccd.png[/img]

Each evening, you can decide to spend some quality time with one person. If you successfully deepen your relationship, you will be rewarded: Having trouble finding a dungeon? See if you can find someone who made it through and how they gained access. Monster too tough to beat? Why not seek out a pro slayer to learn a new special attack, visit Hannah’s smithy and be rewarded with powerful sword enchantments. Or maybe you just want to befriend the village dog because he’s so cute! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/a90adea6b2a4aa2369d14457de810707beec6403.png[/img]

Building strong relationships adds a touch of magic to your journey and holds the key to becoming a formidable slayer!

notes.title: Meet the Microbird Team!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
 
We’re so excited we’ve finally been able to share more on Dungeons of Hinterberg with you all! 
 
Now that we’ve talked a little about the game, we thought we’d introduce you to our “Micro” but mighty team here at Microbird Games! We’ll throw it over to our Community Manager, Luke, who we hear is going to take you on a virtual tour of our team. 

That’s right! Hello! I’m Luke, Community Manager on Dungeons of Hinterberg, I get the privilege of showing all the amazing things the team here is working on! You may be surprised to find that Dungeons of Hinterberg is being developed by a team of just 10! Let’s find out who they are and what they’re up to! 

🤫  2707948938
 
First up, our Co-Founders!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/96ff4c56412a43ac48e26dc3e96b2e2469b28855.png[/img]
[b]Regina - Art Director[/b]

[i]Hey everyone, I'm Regina, co-Founder of Microbird and Art Director on Dungeons of Hinterberg. I've worked on games of all kinds for nearly 8 years as a 3D artist, before Philipp and I founded Microbird in 2020. I'm the one responsible for the look/dev of Dungeons of Hinterberg, which means I spent a lot of time defining and implementing our artstyle, choosing colours and creating unique moods for all our levels and settings. I also do some concept art and 3d models for characters and environments. Beyond all the fun art stuff, being a founder also entails some less creative things, like doing taxes, creating plans, or writing lots of emails. All in all, our journey so far has certainly been an adventure and a wild ride, and I wouldn't miss it for the world.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/7f47a5ad3ed604d2307aae16ef74b8e36bb8e26f.png[/img]
[b]Philipp - Technical Director[/b]

[i]Hi, I’m Philipp, co-founder and technical director at Microbird. I’m responsible for all kinds of gameplay mechanics, from character movement to enemy AI. I’ve also written most of our in-game dialogue, done a bit of level design, and Regina and I share responsibility for the game’s overall design. As you’ll see, most of our team wear different hats all the time, and that’s what I really love about this project - since we’re such a small company, everybody has to think about and can contribute to the game as a whole, not just their particular area of expertise. [/i]
 

Thanks, both! Being Co-Founders must keep you very busy, is there anything you can share on what you’ve been up to recently? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/f142abdb8872e38ff7fe2509461612dcaf230c91.jpg[/img]

[i]A few weeks ago, we went to Gamescom in Cologne to let the press get their hands on an early demo for the first time. It’s been an incredible experience to read all the coverage afterwards - we had been working on this game for years, and we had to stay silent about it for a lot of that time, so being able to finally share some of it and seeing all the reactions feels amazing![/i]


Let’s see who else I can steal away from their busy dev work! Ah here we go, Clio!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/044f00cd0c37e799fb5692d18bff16ab725439cc.png[/img]
[b]Clio - Producer[/b]

[i]I’m the producer here at Microbird! I used to work full time in music (and I still do it on the side), singing for opera, film and tv productions as well as for game soundtracks, composing, and doing arts management. My job at Microbird is to make plans for our team, and then make them happen. Sometimes I get to do other fun tasks, like working on short texts and helping implement some stories and audio. I grew up in Canada and moved to Austria for my master’s degree (and then stayed), so I can really relate to some of the characters in Hinterberg! [/i]


Thanks, Clio! I’ll try not to take much more of your busy Producer time, is there anything you can share that you’ve been up to recently?


[previewyoutube=hWbBSmbaEHI;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]I often use a digital whiteboard to prototype my planning before putting things into our production calendar. Here’s a simplified planning workflow to illustrate some of the priorities we might choose to focus on for a milestone. This provides me with a framework to start calculating productivity points![/i]


Alright, let’s roll out and find another bird! Who do we have next? I spot a wild Tom, let’s see what he’s up to.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/710fa2b9fe00d432916465cc31bf6a77b78315e4.png[/img]
[b]Tom - Senior 3D Artist[/b]

[i]Hi! My name is Tom and I work as a Senior 3D Artist at Microbird. I create concepts, 3D models and rigs for characters and enemies. I also transition level blockouts to final art. I moved to Vienna to study Game Art & 3D Animation in 2014. Since then I have worked on several game productions from Indie to AAA. When I'm not looking at a screen I try to move my body in the form of hiking and enjoying the outdoors.[/i]


Thanks, Tom! Sounds like a lot of steps are involved in creating a character! Could you give us a sneak peek at some rigging?


[previewyoutube=v2zDzKMcAi0;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]A Hinterberg character is usually done by one artist, from concept to modelling and texturing to rigging and finally the Unity implementation. It is a lot of fun and variety to accompany the character from start to finish. Here you can see a short clip of one of our characters in the rigging process.[/i]


As I continue to prowl around the studio, I notice another developer, who do we have here? Oh, another Philipp!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/d84e422864add13d821aae770bb51071a71424b3.png[/img]
[b]Philipp - Gameplay Programmer[/b]

[i]Hi, I’m another Philipp. I’m a general gameplay programmer working on various things like enemies, player attacks, puzzle logic, and basically anything else that needs doing. I mostly work on game logic, but since I have a background as a 2D/3D artist, I’m a bit more flexible with how much of any given gameplay element I can do myself without adding to an artist’s workload.[/i]


Before I run off to find our next dev, can you share a little on something you’ve recently or are currently working on?


[previewyoutube=080uFIm-hlI;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Here I am working on some pretty butterflies that will help make the outdoors feel more alive. Currently we have nine different kinds, based on the most common butterflies in Austria.[/i]


Wow, already halfway through the team! Next up, we have Johannes!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/4c2d0289f88b731370c681eaac08976ed2fc2d3b.png[/img]
[b]Johannes - Programmer[/b]

[i]Hi! I am one of the programmers behind Dungeons of Hinterberg!  

I do quite a lot of different nerdy code things in the background you probably never have thought you’d need for a game, from making sure Luisa loses the correct HP numbers in combat to giving you an option to save the game (well, you probably thought about that before).  

I am also heavily involved in the creation of the story of the game - again, the technical part. I wrote all the code that allows you to befriend our villagers and I made sure that collected loot stays in your inventory. 

Another big aspect of my tasks is the user interface and implementing a great deal of the audio (created by our audio partners, Wobblersound). The latest addition to the task list is porting. 

My non-programmer time is usually spent with my band (I am the drummer) or with a fun side project.[/i]


Thank you, Johannes! Is there anything you’d like to share with the community that you’re currently working on or have worked on? 


[previewyoutube=vyJ4K73K_sg;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]I am adding SFX to moving elements in one of our swamp levels. My job here is to make sure that all the rotating platforms have their proper sound playing whenever they are switched on and also stop their audio when being switched off.[/i]


Now Dungeons of Hinterberg has it’s plethora of Dungeons (25 in fact!) and other locations, as well as puzzles to conquer and much more, and we need someone who can curate that into something you, the player, has to overcome. Let’s check in with Oliver and see what he’s been up to.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/05d8e26706f0ca8895120d6da61b05c4574adbd5.png[/img]
[b]Oliver - Designer[/b]

[i]Allo Allo! I'm the main Designer of the team and known for the one in the office who drinks a lot of tea or the guy that always wears a beanie (even in summer) and much more. 

Anyways, I do the majority of the level and puzzle designs in the game.  

My job usually consists of:  [/i]

[i][list]
[*] Adding a lot of gray cubes into a scene 
[*] Thinking about how to fry the brains of players 
[*] Convincing everyone why adding my favourite enemy to every encounter is a good design decision 
[/list][/i]
[i]When I'm not designing stuff, I like to play other video games, go hiking or place mediocrely in my local Smash or Guilty Gear Tournaments.[/i]


Thanks, Oliver! What is your process for working on a puzzle?


[previewyoutube=FmAHSc19A1o;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]This is how I usually work on a puzzle. I prepare the layout of the puzzle with blockout shapes that I can edit very quickly. Afterwards I use existing elements and design the logic of the puzzle. (In this case, once the player hits the snowflake switch a wall rises from the ground.[/i]


As I continue my adventure through the office, I see bright beautiful colours on a screen, that can only mean one thing, an artist! Actually, no… TWO artists! Let’s see what Victoria and Khiet have been up to.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/8b7d42deccff321ed383231dd854063a62cb4080.png[/img]
[b]Victoria – 3D Artist[/b]

[i]Heyo! I’m Victoria! I started as an intern at Microbird and continued working as a 3D Artist during my studies at the FH Salzburg. Since my focus lies on asset creation, I was responsible for building and set-dressing several locations in the village, but I also have the opportunity to delve into and improve my skills in other areas like characters, vehicles and more recently, dungeon environments. I like to spend my free time working on personal 3D projects, doing handicrafts and having eager conversations about video games and movies.[/i]


Thanks Victoria! Is there a place in particular you can share you recently worked on?


[previewyoutube=KStxx3okvG8;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Here you can see a bit of my process for building the Souvenir Shop in Hinterberg. After brainstorming and collecting ideas, I start modelling and texturing the assets. Finally, I do the set dressing in Unity. [/i] 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/5a1c48c4a1132f0b001aaa90c3cb21649a2d868c.png[/img]
[b]Khiet  – Environment Artist[/b]

[i]Hey hey! You can also call me Nessi (long story). I'm the environment artist here, supporting Regina and Tom with their work and turning gray blockout cubes into all sorts of things that one can imagine. I also get the chance to take my plant mom expertise, interior design and crafting interests to another scale and create lovely environments, in which players can immerse themselves. Apart from that, I'm just a quirky art-loving video game nerd who has too many interests.[/i]


Great stuff, thank you Nessi! Victoria showed us some of her work on the Souvenir Shop players will visit in Hinterberg, could you give us a sneak peek at how world environments are made?


[previewyoutube=_Wk3-NETng4;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Taking a blockout level to the finished look does take some time and revisions, but the overall process is roughly the same: importing the terrain of the blockout level with its grey cubes and rough Unity meshes into the 3D program Maya, modelling the terrain and needed puzzle elements, bringing them back to Unity, then breaking up the uniformness and emptiness with environment assets and adding final touches such as lighting or plants.[/i]


And now, as we come to our close on our team introductions, last but certainly not least, let’s check in with Hannah!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/b96f65199f9df61a99960e0b1f887452208b511d.png[/img]
[b]Hannah – QA Analyst[/b]

[i]Hi, I’m Hannah. My job is all about catching bugs. I’m not an entomologist but the QA Analyst, so I am in charge of finding all the things in the game that don’t work as planned. I solve our levels in creative and alternative ways to make sure you can’t cheat your way around our Level Designer’s amazing ideas. As a computer science graduate I am also able to help with fixing bugs and various other areas such as implementing stories and the mechanics behind saving game elements. This position is my first job in the video game industry and it has been an absolute blast so far. I can’t wait to see what’s to come and am incredibly excited to share Dungeons of Hinterberg with the world.[/i]


Thanks, Hannah! Making sure quality is met across the board must be a challenge, given all of the intricacies of game development! Can you share a little on what the process would be for finding and reporting a bug?


[previewyoutube=0nNvr-goy28;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Part of my job is to find places a player is not supposed to go. Here I found a leak in the fence where Luisa can go off road and potentially hurt herself. We don’t want that, so I used our in house bug-reporting tool to create a ticket and assign it to the person in charge of fixing this issue.[/i]


I LIED! We have one bonus team member to introduce to you, let me introduce you to our office su-paw-star, Barclay!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237016/516f0a5ae602718799e83728f0d66e9be17cf49b.png[/img]
[b]Barclay - The Dog Father[/b]

[i]Hi, my name is Lieutenant Barclay, but everyone just calls me Barcles. My main roles in the company are Chief Morale Officer and Good Boy. I am very proud to be Employee of the Month every month. It’s hard work; that’s why I sleep a lot to keep my strength up. Apart from that I usually protect the office, but since the Human employees don’t seem to enjoy my barking, I have toned it down to a warning gurgle whenever someone rings the doorbell. This seems to be a good compromise for everyone. So far, none of the visitors have been hostile, so I think I’m doing a good job.[/i]


Thank you, Barclay, that’s a good boy! 
 
And that’s a wrap! We hope you enjoyed meeting our team, we’d love to take this time to give a huge shoutout and thanks to you, our community, for all the supportive messages we’ve received. This truly has inspired and motivated us here in the studio, we can’t wait to share even more Dungeons of Hinterberg details very soon! 
 
Stay tuned here by following us on Steam, we’ll be sharing more news more often! And for all things Dungeons of Hinterberg, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MicrobirdGames]Twitter (X)[/url], and join us on [url=https://discord.gg/bgz8mHyYj2]Discord[/url]. 
 
If you like what you see, please consider wishlisting the game today! 
 
What intrigued you most? Drop us a message in the comments below! Feel free to send us your questions, and what else you’d like to see in upcoming news!
